Title: JYHAD: Need cards by NeNe Thomas

Messages.Author: Michael Alan Bielec
Messages.Body:
I need the Net's help in finding which cards from Jyhad are drawn by NeNe 
Thomas.  So far I know of the following :

	.44 Magnum
	Business Pressure
	Glaser Rounds
	Kindred Segregation
	Political Flux
	Rumors of Gehenna

If you can find in your collections any more that are not on this list, 
please mail me at bootz@umich.edu and let me know.  If you'd be willing 
to part with them, even better  :)

Thanks,
Dark Angel

I was thinking recently about building a "Fun" deck, using Malkavians 
(only) and all of the fun cards (like Vampiric Disease, Madness 
Network, and all of the other non-sense-and-not-very-useful-cards)

You just gave me an idea.  I don't know how familiar you are with 
Vampire: the Mascarade RPG, but one of the rumours circulating in the 
vampiric society is that Gehenna (their end of the world) will come if a 
Caitiff ever becomes Prince of a City.

So, what I'll make sure to do is to include in my fun deck 1 Caitiff, at 
least 1 Praxis Seizure: City, and one Rumours of Gehenna, making sure to 
play them in the proper order...
